g.text: HNSW — greedy descent through a layered proximity graph
— every point; at most 2·M links per node
links kept per node; memory ∝ M
latency both rise with it. Overridable
the level of a new point is drawn from a
geometric distribution with m_L = 1 / ln M,
Θ(log n) layers, each a bounded greedy
walk, each hop one d-dimensional SIMD
dot product. Exact search is Θ(n · d).
